messages:
jess_support: Hey team — urgent from ACCT-4828. Customer reports embeddings page shows a huge jump in "units" and billing spike. They say unit type says "tokens" but the numbers match their vector counts (and appear doubled). Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screens/acct-4828.png
sam_oncall: Thanks Jess. Can you drop the original customer request + sample request IDs? want to repro. also which org+model are they on?
jess_support: Org: acme-corp, model: text-embed-ada-002. Sample ids: req_98765, req_98766. Customer ran 3000 vectors -> dashboard shows ~6000 units. They were billed for the 6000.
maria_analytics: :eyes: I pulled the pipeline logs for that org around 2025-10-02T14:12Z. Found two ingestion events for the same request_id for a short window. Looks like dedupe filter didn't run for the batched replay job (replay job id 6421).
deploy-bot: job replay-6421 failed at 2025-10-02T14:11:58Z with error "duplicate_event_detect: missing_event_id"; retry scheduled.
sam_oncall: That could explain doubling. But why is UI labeling vectors as tokens? Is it a UI mapping issue or metric transform error?
maria_analytics: UI layer reads metric.unit_name from metrics_api. For those events metric.unit_name was "tokens" due to a remapping script that applies legacy name for embed-unit metrics when source=legacy_ingest. Looks like the replay flagged the source as legacy, forcing unit_name=tokens.
kevin_pm: So two bugs in one: events duplicated + unit remap. Any quick repro SQL we can run?
maria_analytics: Run this to compare raw events vs processed rollups:

```
SELECT event_id, request_id, source, units, unit_name, received_at
FROM embed_events_raw
WHERE org_id='acme-corp' AND received_at >= '2025-10-02T14:00:00Z'
ORDER BY received_at;
```

If you see same request_id twice with source IN ('batch-replay','legacy_ingest') that's the problem.
jess_support: I ran the SQL in staging and reproduced: req_98765 appears twice, units=1 each, unit_name shows "tokens" on one row and "vectors" on the other.
sam_oncall: For mitigation we should: 1) pause replays for that period, 2) run a dedupe migration to remove duplicate raw events, 3) ensure metric.unit_name mapping is consistent. I'll open infra task.
kevin_pm: Customer needs either credit or corrected invoice. Jess, did we already credit?
jess_support: Issued a temporary credit of $420 and told customer we're investigating. They accepted but asked for ETA.
maria_analytics: ETA: I'd estimate 6-8 hours to run safe dedupe + re-run rollups in analytics. UI fix to stop remapping legacy->tokens is a quick 1hr change but needs a canary.
sam_oncall: I'll file infra ticket INF-1129 to pause replays and run dedupe; assign to @sam_oncall and @maria_analytics. Starting now.
kevin_pm: Keep me posted. If we hit more customers we'll expand credits. :thumbsup:
jess_support: Thanks. I'll update the customer and attach this thread. cc @kevin_pm @maria_analytics :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: ticket INF-1129 created: https://redwood-internal/tickets/INF-1129
maria_analytics: quick note: guard clause to ensure unit_name is taken from the model mapping table (preferred) not from source payload. I'll open a PR for the UI mapping change.
sam_oncall: Good. After dedupe + reroll we'll verify dashboard numbers match embeddings_count and invoice. Assigning follow-up to next standup.
kevin_pm: good work team. jess_support please include the invoice numbers when you reply.
jess_support: Will do. Closing loop after reroll. :slightly_smiling_face:
